description: Shared cross-language SDK validation corpus. Every SDK validator must agree on the pass/fail outcome of every fixture. Assertions are boolean (pass/fail) only; error text varies across validator libraries. Rules mirror the language-neutral validation contract: envelope, message dispatch, payload required fields, vertical validation, strict ping allowlist + ping_safe, offer validation, and uuid/date-time/date/email/uri format assertions.

fixtures.description: Valid full lead envelope (example shape, no expiry/exclusivity).
Valid ping with only ping-safe fields (HMAC phone hash, banded attributes).
Envelope missing lcp.version.
Unknown message type must be rejected with a structured error.
Message id is not a UUID.
Message timestamp is not ISO 8601 date-time.
Consumer email is not a valid email address.
Consumer dob is not an ISO 8601 date.
Consent source URL is not a valid URI.
Lead consumer has no name, email, or phone — violates the contact anyOf requirement.
Mortgage attributes use a loan_type outside the vertical enum.
Ping attributes carry loan_amount_cents which is ping_safe: false — must not cross the ping boundary.
Offer missing floor_price_cents and currency.
Valid offer.
LEP-0003 §1: valid v1.1 ping advertising slots_available to a v1.1 peer (strict allowlist gains the reviewed non-PII count).
LEP-0003 §2: valid v1.1 bid with single-slot claim (1..1).
LEP-0003 §3: valid v1.1 post carrying per-pair keyed contacted_hashes (64-hex, phone-form per the §9 gate).

LEP-0003 invalid example B (#153 T7): exclusive lead advertising slots_available 3 contradicts the one-slot special case — rejected by the ping.json top-level conditional (exclusive implies slots_available const 1), not just by prose.
LEP-0003 invalid example A: unsalted SHA-1-shaped 40-hex contacted hash fails the ^[a-f0-9]{64}$ per-pair HMAC form (SPEC.md §9, §14 B3).
RF-1 defect class: a 63-hex truncated digest fails the same shape rule (the ARB re-dossier caught exactly this in the record's own example).
101 contacted_hashes entries exceed the bounded post-direction maxItems 100 (LEP-0003 Deferred questions: bulk suppression sync MUST NOT ride this field).
slots_available 0 violates minimum 1: zero remaining means stop pinging, not ping with zero (LEP-0003 §1).
slots_claimed 2 is out of range for v1.1 (maximum 1): multi-slot agency claims have no delivery path and are deferred (#153 T5, LEP-0003 §2/F4).
Attestation is free text (#192 forgery A): schema shape rejects it before verification.

agent.attestation: trust me, I am a real agent

fixtures.description: Attestation has two segments: compact JWS requires three.
Attestation carries base64 padding: canonical form excludes "=" (LEP-0002 generation discipline).
Attestation exceeds the 8192-character bound.
Attestation has the canonical three-segment compact-JWS shape (verification is not schema-expressible).
